BFA.note: Reports an ODIN rating; no standards body membership or adopted standard.
Mentions a portal and a rating but no open data policy.

facts.fact: leFaso.net reports INSD presented the Burkina open data platform, set up in 2016 with African Development Bank funding, where data is available in machine-readable Excel format.
leFaso.net reports the Burkina open data platform brings together in one place the statistical outputs of the different ministries, with data on health, education and household living standards.
